Chapter 6374: So Strong

Chapter 6374: So Strong

Absolute Ancestor overwhelmed the horde empowered by their grand momentum. The disparity in power was insurmountable.

Therefore, the combined force led by the two emperors stood no chance. As the blood lake crumbled, so did the members of the formations. The lucky survivors cried out to Tenth-gen Chen for help.

Meanwhile, others watched in awe. They knew about her might since she was the youngest heaven-slayer. However, she rarely appeared, let alone fight.

Centurial Peak reacted by sending out chain-like blood rays. Blood dripped from them as they gathered in the air, forming a palm to stop the badge.

“Absolute Void!” She focused up, releasing her murderous intent and sacred anima.

This sacred source brimmed with power, life, and destruction. It empowered the badge for another attack.

The world turned dark due to the massive influx of energy. The badge cut through the reincarnation cycle, reducing living beings into ashes.

The palm was created by blood laws, not a true hand. Thus, the badge easily severed it and continued for Centurial Peak.

Thick laws rushed to the sky defensively but failed to slow it down.

“Crack!” Cracks appeared all over Centurial Peak. Its grand momentum used by Goldclad and Lostmetal couldn’t stop it.

During this key moment, the image of the blood lake appeared again and a person stepped out. The lake minimized and became a circle behind him.

As he raised his hand, all affinities and laws followed.

“Bam!” He stopped the badge and looked at ease, seemingly in complete control.

“Tenth-gen Chen.” Spectators murmured his title.

“Only a dao avatar?” Absolute Ancestor glared at the man.

“My niece, you have a long way to go. This dao avatar is sufficient.” He said indifferently.

No hint of anger and murderous intent was found in his voice. Nevertheless, listeners including Crimson Virtue and Solar shuddered.

Absolute Ancestor had refined her sacred source three times already. However, he didn’t seem to think much of it.

“Ten Generations Press.” He mustered a dao chapter in his palm and sent it forward.

“Boom!” Everyone felt Desolate Frontier itself being pushed away for thousands of miles. They lost their footing and were sent flying.

“Absolute Seal.” She blocked it with her badge, turning space and time into an impregnable wall.

Unfortunately, the wall crumbled and she was also sent flying while vomiting blood.

This exchange astounded everyone. She easily subdued the others so how did this dao avatar defeat her?

“A being comparable to Ancestor Jiang.” Crimson Virtue told Solar.

They had tried to suppress the Chen previously to no avail. The Chen were strong but most importantly, their leader was strong enough to deter North Kun God and Everlasting Jiang.

If the duo wanted to kill Tenth-gen Chen, they would have to pay a heavy price. Therefore, just his dao avatar alone was enough to send Absolute Ancestor flying.
